name: 5-fluoro-AMT
summary: 5-Fluoro-αMT, also known as 5-fluoro-α-methyltryptamine (5F-AMT) or by its developmental code names PAL-212 and PAL-544, is a monoaminergic drug of the tryptamine and α-alkyltryptamine families related to α-methyltryptamine (αMT). It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: 5-Fluoro-AMT has been found to act as a fairly balanced serotonin-norepinephrine-dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA), as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist, and as a potent and specific MAO-A inhibitor. Its EC50 values in terms of monoamine release are 14 to 19 nM for serotonin, 78 to 126 nM for norepinephrine, and 32 to 37 nM for dopamine in rat brain synaptosomes.

uses.en: It is a research compound used in laboratory studies of monoamine release. It is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於單胺釋放的實驗室研究，並不是藥品。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用於单胺释放的实验室研究，并不是药品。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Blocking monoamine oxidase while also releasing serotonin raises the risk of serotonin syndrome and of dangerous rises in blood pressure. Related α-alkyltryptamines can cause nausea, muscle tension, a racing heart, overheating and anxiety.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。一方面抑制單胺氧化酶、一方面又釋放血清素，會提高血清素症候群與血壓危險升高的風險。相關的α-烷基色胺類可能引起噁心、肌肉緊繃、心跳急促、體溫過高與焦慮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。一方面抑制单胺氧化酶、一方面又释放血清素，会提高血清素症候群与血压危险升高的风险。相关的α-烷基色胺类可能引起恶心、肌肉紧绷、心跳急促、体温过高与焦虑。

fact.en: As well as releasing serotonin, dopamine and noradrenaline, it strongly blocks the enzyme MAO-A. That combination is unusual, and it is one reason the compound is studied in laboratories.
fact.zh: 它除了釋放血清素、多巴胺與正腎上腺素之外，還會強力抑制酵素MAO-A。這樣的組合並不常見，也是它成為實驗室研究對象的原因之一。
fact.zhHans: 它除了释放血清素、多巴胺与正肾上腺素之外，还会强力抑制酵素MAO-A。这样的组合并不常见，也是它成为实验室研究对象的原因之一。
